# Test files the macOS PULL-REQUEST cell of CI leaves to the Linux and Windows cells.
# Read by the step "Leave the heavy platform-neutral test files to the other cells" of the `test`
# job in .github/workflows/ci.yml, which turns each line into `--ignore=<file>` for pytest, on
# `test (macos-latest, ...)` of a pull request run and on no other cell. The nightly run, the
# release branch and a manual dispatch run every one of these files on macOS.
#
# A line is ONE top-level test file name, `tests/test_<name>.py`: no option, no glob, no path
# below tests/. A file belongs here only if it takes a minute or more on macOS AND carries no
# platform or process-model token (`sys.platform`, `darwin`, `mlx`, `mps`, `subprocess`,
# `spawn`, `symlink`, ...: the two patterns in tests/test_ci_macos_pr_skip_list.py). Keep the
# list sorted, at most 40 lines. Why and how it was chosen: that test file's docstring.
#
# Measured 2026-11-18 on commit 14be6a450, one green job per OS (macOS: 3 xdist workers, 88.1
# minutes; Linux: 4 workers, 25.6 minutes): these files took 125.6 of the macOS cell's 262.3
# worker-minutes and 17.4 of the Linux cell's 100.9. Re-measure before adding a line.
